with the same operation_id is safe. An upload's receipt says its state now: uploading when
its bytes did not arrive (send the identical call again), checking while ThreadPage checks a
file, uploaded once its bytes are stored (a file's also checked, with the markdown line that

tools.description:
Upload a file to use in a Note (Add only and up): any type, up to 5 MB, as base64 (it
passes through your own output, so keep it small or ask the person to add a large one). It
counts toward the same daily limit as images. For a Note that already exists, pass its
note_id. Uploading does not add it to the Note: then put it on its own line in the Note's
Markdown, [name](attachment:<file_id>) (the answer's markdown), or as a document block
{"type": "file", "attrs": {"attachmentId": "<file_id>", "name": "…"}}. Place it once its
state is uploaded (get_operation shows it); placed while checking, the write answers
attachment_upload_in_progress: wait details.retry_after seconds and send it again.

tools.description:
Upload an image to use in a Note (Add only and up): PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB
and 20 megapixels, as base64 (it passes through your own output, so keep it small or ask the
person to add a large one). ThreadPage never fetches a URL. For a Note that already exists,
pass its note_id. Then put it on its own line in the Note's Markdown:
![What the image shows](attachment:<attachment_id>), or a document block
{"type": "image", "attrs": {"attachmentId": "<attachment_id>", "alt": "…", "width": null}}.

operation_id.description: A new UUID for each write. After a lost answer, send the identical call with the same one, or check get_operation before writing again.

data.description: The image file as base64: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
